patch.value: GH-824: core-field recovery must name dedicated flags instead of extension activation
Core fields passed through --field are misclassified as unknown extension fields, and close-validation warnings expose snake_case names without executable flag recovery.
Core field names passed to --field return the canonical dedicated update/close flag; close-validation warnings include executable flags; tests execute every rendered recovery command
Make core-field validation errors directly recoverable in one CLI turn
Agents can satisfy resolution metadata without guessing flags or activating irrelevant extensions
Removes a deterministic dead-end from close validation and generic field setting
